name: UW Biomechatronics Design Team (Biotron)
description: Creates solutions for problems in the biomedical field through four specialized sub-teams.

cycles.notes: Join the Discord, then pick a sub-team in the #roles channel (EMG Fabric, e-NABLE, or EXO, and you can join more than one). Attend team meetings to learn more and start on projects. Questions go to the Leads on Discord or by email. No formal application.
